headline: Akademiks: Le Bebe Mocks Bendadonn Over 2-Year-Old YouTube Title
body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram post where Le Bebe is humorously complaining to Bendadonn about a YouTube title from two years ago. The post, published September 6, 2026, has garnered 9,756 likes and 448 comments. The caption reads: 'Le Bebe complaining like a lil schoolgirl to bendadonn over a YouTube title from 2 years ago.' This viral moment highlights the playful banter between these artists, showcasing their ongoing internet presence and mutual teasing.
